interface.title: SLIM — Single-cell Analysis in Minutes
interface.stage_of_work: Primary analysis of a single-cell count matrix: loading, QC, normalization/dimensionality reduction, clustering, annotation, differential expression and export
interface.what_it_is_for: A Streamlit app with one tab per step that takes a researcher from an uploaded single-cell count matrix through QC filtering, HVG/PCA preprocessing, Leiden/UMAP clustering, marker-based annotation and Wilcoxon DEG to downloadable results, including a CSV for the BRIM bulk RNA-seq tool.

data.note: pbmc_mini_counts.csv (genes x cells, 6.9 KB) was uploaded with File Type 'csv' and loaded as 24 cells x 120 genes. The 'Load Sample Data (Mouse PBMC)' button was not pressed, as instructed, because it needs internet access the server does not have. Clustering fails with "No module named 'leidenalg'". According to the reviewer, leidenalg and python-igraph are missing from the repo's requirements.txt, so this is a dependency omission in the repo, not a server limit. Because of it, Annotate, DEG and the result downloads were not reached in this run.

tree.general: Turn a raw table of per-cell gene counts into filtered, normalized, reduced data, then into labelled groups of cells and the genes that differ between them
tree.specific: Take pbmc_mini_counts.csv through Upload, QC and Preprocess in SLIM and review the run in the Export tab's Analysis Log. Cluster, Annotate, DEG and the result downloads were not reached in this run.

children.specific: Set Min Genes to 100 (Max Genes 5000, Max Mito % 20), press Apply QC, and read the gene-count and mito % violins and 'Cells (After): 20'

hovered the top outlier point on the Gene Count violin (n_genes_by_counts=115)

children.specific: Apply QC with the default Min Genes 200, which gives 'Cells (After): 0' and empty violins. Then drag Min Genes to 100 and apply again. The 20 cells come back, which shows that each QC run starts from the uploaded data, not from the last result.

children.general: Normalize, select variable genes and reduce dimensions
Normalize, select highly variable genes and run PCA, then check how variance falls across components
children.specific: With Number of PCs set to 10 (the default of 30 must be lowered when there are only 20 cells), Run Preprocessing draws the Elbow Plot (PCA Variance Ratio).

children.label: set Number of PCs slider to 10 (Home key)

children.general: Re-run computing more principal components to see where the variance drops off
children.specific: Set Number of PCs to 15 (HVG count was also set to 500) and run again. The elbow is flat to about PC 8 and drops sharply after PC 9–10. With only 120 genes the HVG setting changes nothing: PCs 1–10 match the first run, and only the extra PCs show the drop. The Export log records both runs.

features.name: Threshold sliders with before/after cell count and distribution violins
features.general: Set lower and upper cut-offs on per-cell quality metrics (genes detected, mitochondrial fraction), apply them, see the distribution of the cells that remain and how many passed, and re-apply with other cut-offs without losing the original data
features.specific: QC tab: Min Genes / Max Genes / Max Mito % sliders, Apply QC, Plotly violins of n_genes_by_counts and pct_counts_mt with jittered points and hover values, and a 'Cells (After): N' message. Each run filters from the uploaded matrix, and the result is passed to Preprocess and logged.
steps: drag Min Genes / Max Genes / Max Mito % sliders
press Apply QC
read the Cells (After) count and the violins of the surviving cells
hover outlier points to read their values
loosen or tighten a slider and apply again
serves_tasks: Set quality thresholds and confirm how many cells pass
Try a too-strict threshold, then loosen it and filter again

features.name: Parameterised normalization and PCA with elbow plot
features.general: Choose how many variable genes to keep and how many principal components to compute, run the reduction, judge from a variance-per-component curve how many components carry signal, and re-run with other settings
features.specific: Preprocess tab: HVG count (500–5000) and Number of PCs (10–50) sliders, Run Preprocessing (normalize, HVG, PCA), and an Elbow Plot (PCA Variance Ratio) line chart. Invalid settings show an error banner, for example when PCs exceed the number of cells. The chart has Plotly's standard hover, box-zoom, reset-axes and PNG download (elbow-plot-pca-variance-ratio.png).
steps: set HVG count slider
set Number of PCs slider
press Run Preprocessing
read the elbow plot and hover points for exact variance ratios
adjust and re-run if the elbow is not visible
serves_tasks: Normalize, select highly variable genes and run PCA, then check how variance falls across components
Re-run computing more principal components to see where the variance drops off

features.name: Typed file upload with shape summary
features.general: Declare the format of a data file, upload and submit it, and confirm the cell and gene counts and the per-cell metadata before analysis. A format mismatch gives a readable error.
features.specific: Upload tab: File Type radio (h5ad / csv / 10x_zip), drag-and-drop uploader (200 MB, H5AD/CSV/ZIP), Submit Upload, success or error banner, Cells/Genes metrics, and a 'Show Metadata (obs)' expander table (first 5 rows)
steps: choose File Type
upload file
press Submit Upload
read Cells and Genes metrics
expand Show Metadata (obs)
serves_tasks: Load a count matrix and check how many cells and genes it has
Look at the per-cell metadata table

features.name: Step-wise analysis log with session reset
features.general: Keep an automatic, timestamped record of each processing step and its parameters, and clear all state to start a fresh run
features.specific: Export tab 'Analysis Log' table (Time / Action / Details) records Data Loaded, QC Applied (cells before/after and thresholds) and each Preprocessing Done (HVG, PCs). Failed runs are not logged. The sidebar 'Reset All Data' removes the table.
steps: run analysis steps on other tabs
open Export to read the log
repeat a step with new parameters and see a new row
press Reset All Data to clear
serves_tasks: Check a timestamped log of each analysis step and its parameters
Clear all results and start over
